style: 3D animated, Pixar quality, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: the hermit crab moves his whole body from rock to rock every beat; waves, foam and spray never stop; the camera orbits the crab nonstop, new shot size every beat; the crab fills half the frame except the three close-up beats
character: the crab: small hermit crab, long eyestalks, one oversized claw, wearing a glossy pink ceramic piggy bank with a coin slot as his shell, no markings; ONE tiny octopus inspector in a plain peaked cap, no badge, wide toothy grin, lives inside it, until 6.5 only ONE eye blinking in the slot, tentacle in a white shirt cuff
props: ONE piggy bank; ONE blank sheet pulled out at 7.2
environment: rocky sea edge at low tide: big wet ochre boulders with deep cracks, breaking waves, white foam, spray, wet sand
lighting: glints on wet rock, glossy pink ceramic

audio.delivery: raspy small male voice, nervous, 4.7 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: mne ka-ZA-los', ya ot na-LO-go-voy PRYA-chus'. o-ka-ZA-los', shto o-NI u-ZHE DA-zhe v moy PAN-tsir' za-LEZ-li
audio.pacing: first word at 0.35; 0.35-6.5 one continuous flow, no pause inside; after 6.5 not a word, sfx go on
audio.sfx: sand spray, wave crash, ceramic scrape, paper flutter

timeline.a: a wave bursts into foam on the boulders; the crab in the piggy bank shoots out of the foam onto a wet boulder; ONE eye blinks in the slot
timeline.c: low at the waterline, orbit right

timeline.a: the crab sidesteps along the boulder lip, mouthparts snapping open, eyestalks swinging into the lens, filling the frame, piggy bank clattering; foam round his legs
timeline.c: close-up, low, spray in the foreground

timeline.a: he scuttles sideways at full speed right to left over wet sand between boulders, legs a blur, piggy bank swaying, eyestalks darting back; a wave breaks behind
timeline.c: orbit low, wet rocks in the foreground

timeline.a: he scrambles diagonally over the boulder's crest away from camera, the piggy bank wobbling; the slot eye blinks twice
timeline.c: high angle, orbit over the crest

timeline.a: he backs shell-first into a narrow crack, it jams halfway, all legs shoving; a wave foams over his legs
he backs out and scuttles in a curve round the boulder, eyestalks twisted back; the slot eye blinks after him
ONE tentacle in a cuff whips out of the slot and shoves; the piggy bank tips over, the crab tumbles out, pale curled tail end bare, rolls across the sand, legs flailing
timeline.c: camera drops and rushes in at sand level

timeline.a: the octopus squeezes out of the slot and flings ONE blank sheet at the lens, the flapping sheet filling the frame; it drops, the crab leaps and snatches it in both claws
the crab backs diagonally away across the sand, sheet in both claws beside his body, flat and square to camera, trembling; foam washes by
the octopus on the tipped piggy bank slaps it and lunges up close, grin filling the frame; in front, the crab backs off, shaking the sheet
timeline.c: close-up, low angle, spray in the foreground

timeline.a: the crab wraps the sheet round his tail end like a shell and scuttles off over the boulders, eyestalks back; the octopus waves his cap

negative_prompt: microphone, extra characters, slow motion, any word after 6.5, silent tail, accented Russian, letters, numbers, subtitles, watermark, English speech, extra word, duplicate props, floating objects, a stamp, far shot, night, cut, scene change
